name: @uomd/android
description: Capacitor Android shell of Unaware of My Demise (native Google sign-in, Play Billing, AdMob/UMP bridges). The native project in ./android is committed and reproducible in CI.

scripts.sync: npm run build:web && cap sync android
scripts.apk: npm run sync && node scripts/build.mjs gradle assembleDebug
scripts.aab: npm run check:release && npm run sync && node scripts/build.mjs gradle bundleRelease
